purpose: Task-local excerpts for PLAN_REVIEW plan-v2 because the bounded product-manager snapshot excludes installed Skill and plugin paths.

facts.fact: Enter-EvidenceLock already protects one evidence directory with FileShare.None.
Reserve-GlobalIdempotencyKey uses FileMode.CreateNew, flushes durably, and stores automaticResendAllowed=false.
Every command currently acquires the single fixed Local\ChatGptProSidebarV1 mutex, so distinct tabs are serialized.
New-SendIntentState records prompt/idempotency/baseline/URL/targetBinding but has no CodexThreadId parameter or state field.
TargetBinding contains browserId/profileId/profileLabel/tabId/sessionKey/origin/url and exact matching requires the four opaque runtime identities.
ExpectedBinding is exact; recovery requires one exact canonical URL in the same unambiguous profile/browser; unbound multiple tabs fail AgentBrowserTargetAmbiguous.
send does not pass a caller-supplied target binding; run creates a new chat internally and passes only that returned binding.
RootWait continuation validation already binds codexThreadId and watcherId to terminal local evidence.
ensure_unique_session_dir uses exists() in a loop and returns a candidate without atomic creation.
BridgeSession.write_status writes status.json directly with write_text.
append_gptpro_evidence performs an unlocked read-modify-write; dedupe is provider/sessionId/round and the final evidence write is direct write_text.
save_response prevents conflicting response bytes but then calls the unlocked task-level evidence append before writing session status.
